name: The Album of Ransom Wilkes
source:
"They say that in Greylock, every story is a happy story.

The most interesting stories you would hear around town would be those of family gatherings and church events. You may hear stories about how Lauren Fitzpatrick's son won the baseball game for his school, or about the Terrence kids' lemonade stand on 24th Street.

At first, the story of Ransom Wilkes might just seem like another story you would hear among Greylock's autumn winds. But I find his story to be...a lot more extraordinary than that."

 From the heart of Rhettoe Raven comes an emotional epic. Experience a small part of the life of Ransom Wilkes, as he experiences love, loss, and what it means to live.

[From [url=https://rhettoeraven.itch.io/the-album-of-ransom-wilkes]Itch.io[/url]]
